tips.title: Define virtual tool in XML format
tips.body: Create a .vtx file with an ID matching the macro database and place it in the same location.

tips.title: Set tool data mode to VT
tips.body: In hyperMILL, set the Tool data mode to VT and use the virtual tool ID as the Tool no.

tips.title: Use RuleFilter for tool search criteria
tips.body: Define multiple RuleFilters within SearchFilters to combine conditions with 'And' logic.

tips.title: Set user variable in PreSearchAction
tips.body: Use <Action Type='SetUserVariable'> to define a user variable before tool search.

tips.title: Define post-search actions for tool found or not found
tips.body: Use <ToolFound> and <ToolNotFound> to define actions based on whether a matching tool is found.

tips.title: Define select priority for virtual tools
tips.body: Set global or local select priority using SelectPriority and SelectStrategy elements in VirtualToolFormat.

tips.title: Supported select strategies
tips.body: Four strategies: Min, Max, Sequence, Condition.

tips.title: Variable format in Virtual Tool Definition
tips.body: Variables use the format Object.Parameter or Object.SubObject::Parameter.

tips.title: Common tool variables
tips.body: List of common tool variables includes NCTool, MillingTool, Tool, Head, Holder, Extension, MacroTool, Feature, Connector, JobCfg, Joblist, Macro, EnvVariable.

tips.title: MacroTool variables
tips.body: Supported parameters for MacroTool include ID, NCNumber, Folder, Comment, Diameter, CornerRadius, TipAngle, UsableLength, ClearanceLength, GageLength, Length, ShaftEnabled, ShaftDiameter, ShaftChamferLength, TipLength, TipDiameter, TaperAngle.

tips.title: Feature variable naming convention
tips.body: Feature variables combine main parameter and base object parameters with '::' as separator.

tips.title: Connector variables
tips.body: Connector variables return parameter values of the current active feature connection item.

tips.title: JobCfg variables
tips.body: JobCfg parameters can be used as variables, with '*' allowed only in the first position.

tips.title: Joblist variables
tips.body: Joblist parameters include Machine, Material, CheckMacroMachineGroup, CheckMacroMaterialGroup.

tips.title: Macro variables
tips.body: Macro parameters include MachineGroup and MaterialGroup.

tips.title: Window system environment variables
tips.body: Retrieve values using EnvVariable.[Environment Variable Name].
